body: Founder: 'do more of the reinforcement learning i want the bots to be smarter' -> 'oh put the new checkpoint into the embeddings in the c and push it up.' Promoted the already-trained, already-evaluated (50W/0L/0D vs heuristic) 5,000,000-timestep PPO checkpoint into packages/common/rl_policy_weights.h, superseding the prior 1M-timestep policy. Full rebuild + test_arena.sh + test_10_bots.sh all green. Scope note: this only affects the solo 1v1 local-practice bot, not the networked apps/arena_bot AI players actually face in real matches. The formal old-vs-new face-off validation (backlog item 6) was explicitly superseded by direct promotion per founder instruction, not silently skipped.
title: feat: promote 5M-timestep RL policy checkpoint to live weights
